name: Western Turks after the Tang conquest (Cliopatria 'Turks')

predecessors.name: Tang dynasty
predecessors.text: Zhetysu and the Chu valley with Chach, which the Tang held after the fall of the Western Turkic Khaganate in 657-659 and which the Western Turks hold again, as Tang proxies, from 666

successors.name: Türgesh Khaganate
successors.text: the Taraz core from which Wuzhile founded the Turgesh khaganate in 699 (infobox capitals Taraz and Suyab)

successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: the rest of the Western Turks' land outside the Taraz core, nominally Tang until the Turgesh take it in 703

ledger.x: 666: Buzhen, the last Tang-appointed ruler of the Western Turks' Nushibi, is killed and the Turks continue under Ashina claimants.
666: the Western Turks are the Tang's vassal.
674: the Ili side of Dzungaria, where the Duolu lived, is drawn as Turk land.

674: the Dzungaria piece enters the same Tang overlordship as the Chu and Zhetysu lands ('In 673 the Tang consolidated control over the Wuduolu Turks', Protectorate General to Pacify the West page); the year is Cliopatria's 674 against the page's 673.
677: 'In 677, Duzhi declared himself Onoq Khagan, ruler of all Turks' against the Tang, allied with Tibet (infobox: Duzhi '676–679 (allied with Tibetan Empire)').
677: Duzhi's own tribes are the Wuduolu Turks of Dzungaria ('The Tang had assigned Duzhi control of the Wuduolu Turks'), so the Dzungaria piece leaves the Tang overlordship with his declaration.
677: Ashina Duzhi declares himself Onoq Khagan and takes Kucha with Tibetan help.
679: Pei Xingjian recovers the Four Garrisons and captures Duzhi.
685: 'Empress Wu Zetian sent Yuanqing and Böri westward in 685 to succeed their fathers as proxy rulers' (Yuanqing the son of Mishe, Böri of Buzhen; both had 'resided in Chang'an').
690: Böri 'was able to bring the western tribes temporarily under his rule, but was defeated in 690 during an invasion by the' Second Turkic Khaganate and fled to the Tang (executed 692).
698: the Western Turks' land outside the Taraz core is no one's Turkic state until the Turgesh take it in 703.
698: the Western Turk remnant gives way to the Turgesh.

wars.name: Duzhi's revolt and the Tang recovery of the Four Garrisons
wars.outcome: Duzhi takes Kucha with Tibetan help (677); Pei Xingjian recovers the garrisons and captures him (679).

wars.name: Tibetan capture of Ashina Yuanqing
wars.outcome: Yuanqing, sent west by Wu Zetian in 685, is captured by Tibet between 686 and 689.

wars.name: Second Turkic invasion of the Western Turks
wars.outcome: Böri (Ashina Huseluo) is defeated in 690 by the Second Turkic Khaganate and flees to the Tang with his followers; he is executed in 692.

certainty.note: Tribal grazing lands under Tang, Tibetan and Turkic pressure; no line is given by any page.

sources.title: Protectorate General to Pacify the West
